name: Escorp Asset Management Limited
about: Escorp Asset Management Limited provides portfolio management services in India. The company offers institutional asset management services, such as discretionary fund management, non-discretionary fund advisory, research, and corporate treasury services; and personal finance advisory services, including financial, estate, and succession planning, and personal tax advisory services. It also provides portfolio management services; investment advisory; and research services. In addition, the company invests in shares, securities, and funds. It serves institutions; individuals; HNIs; family offices; and corporates. Escorp Asset Management Limited was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Mumbai, India. Escorp Asset Management Limited is a subsidiary of Aryaman Financial Services Limited.
